summary: @onereach/styles preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package is advertised as CSS/Tailwind styles but ships a preinstall script (setup.mjs, invoked via `node setup.mjs` on npm install) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, unpacks it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled 727KB sibling file `math_init.js`. If Bun is already installed on the host, the local Bun is used directly against the same payload. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated with identifier-mangling and string-array-rotation (obfuscator.io fingerprint: `_0x`-prefixed locals, per-call key-map proxy objects, a `WV8StW` shift-rotation function, and a 1000+ entry mixed literal/numeric array). A styles package has no legitimate need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or for executing an opaque, heavily-obfuscated blob at install time. The behavior fires automatically on `npm install`, and the obfuscation hides the payload's network destinations and actions from casual inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
